local L = game:GetService('Lighting') local out = {} for _, c in L:GetChildren() do local s = c.ClassName .. ':' .. c.Name if c:IsA('Sky') then s ..= ' bk=' .. c.SkyboxBk .. ' up=' .. c.SkyboxUp .. ' celestial=' .. tostring(c.CelestialBodiesShown) .. ' sun=' .. c.SunTextureId end if c:IsA('Atmosphere') then s ..= string.format(' d=%.2f h=%.2f c=%s decay=%s', c.Density, c.Haze, tostring(c.Color), tostring(c.Decay)) end if c:IsA('ColorCorrectionEffect') then s ..= ' tint=' .. tostring(c.TintColor) .. ' sat=' .. c.Saturation end if c:IsA('Clouds') then s ..= ' cover=' .. c.Cover end table.insert(out, s) end local t = workspace.Terrain:FindFirstChildOfClass('Clouds') return table.concat(out, ' || ') .. ' | clock ' .. L.ClockTime .. ' fog ' .. tostring(L.FogColor) .. ' terrainClouds ' .. tostring(t ~= nil) .. ' geo ' .. L.GeographicLatitude
